title: Beefy provides $OP incentives for STG liquidity.
body:
Background
Beefy is a multi-chain yield optimizer present on 21 different blockchains (8 of which are shared with Stargate). Currently offering more than 650 vaults that compound rewards generated by almost $250M TVL. Beefy has many strong traits, two of the most outstanding ones are a big focus on security, and great user experience.
Beefy is a recipient of a Grant from the Optimism Governance Fund. One of the purposes of the grant is to showcase Optimism protocols to our multichain user base.

Proposal
This proposal aims to allocate Beefy’s $OP tokens to boost the STG-USDC Velodrome autocompouding vault, with the goal of attracting more $STG liquidity and tokenholders on Optimism. We will introduce the boost along with some marketing and educational pieces, which will aim to increase awareness and understanding of Stargate’ s protocol and $STG token among Beefy users. As a result of the boost, the users will earn more $STG tokens, as the liquidity incentives from Velodrome are swapped into more $STG and redeposited, plus an extra APR in the form of $OP tokens for staking into the boost.

Beefy’s proposal is to allocate 12,500 $OP tokens to be distributed in the STG-USDC Vault. Beefy will also create the educational and marketing pieces about Stargate, and our development team will create and manage the contracts related to the boost. In return, we are asking for Stargate to stake $3M of STG-USDC as protocol-owned liquidity into the autocompounding Beefy vault, (and not into the boost). This will allow the $OP rewards tol be distributed amongst more users.

Execution
12,500 OP will be allocated to be distributed over 2 to 4 weeks into all users who stake into the boost. The boost would start on 22 July, and the marketing/educational pieces will be released during the boost period to maximize attention.

$3M of STG-USDC POL will be provided into the Beefy vault on Optimism before 22 July.

title: Make Aura and Balancer the STG Liquidity Hub on Arbitrum
body:
-Background-
Currently, Stargate has protocol-owned liquidity in Arbitrum on a 50/50 STG/USDC.e Balancer Pool, with a TVL of more than $1.5M.The pool facilitates STG swaps and earns trading fees. However, the current pool's yield is not optimized because it only benefits from swap fees.

Stargate already has protocol-owned liquidity on mainnet within Aura Finance in a 50/50 STG/bb-a-USD pool.

-Proposal-
Aura Finance is a meta-governance protocol built on top of Balancer. Aura Finance has topped over $700M in TVL on mainnet and has a massive ecosystem of partners that encompasses everything from major lending markets like Aave, to cross-chain infrastructure providers like Stargate, to top LSD providers like Rocketpool and Swell. In total, Aura has obtained and maintained fruitful relationships with over 40 different protocols within DeFi. Based on its success on mainnet, Aura contributors believe in Balancer’s potential to be a first-choice for protocols considering to either seed or grow liquidity. 

Aura helps to amplify the effectiveness and growth of Balancer in addition to the protocols within the ecosystem. Aura’s voting incentive markets are one of the most diverse in DeFi, with over 20-30 active participants on any given round. Moreover, Aura has maintained a solid track record in the accumulation of governance influence for veBAL, which has helped to keep markets lively.

We propose the POL migration from the 50/50 STG/USDC.e pool to an 50/50 STG/Boosted Aave V3 USD pool staked within Aura, leveraging the current pool/gauge already available in Balancer and approved by BIP 258. Boosted pools included pools in which a portion of the liquidity, which is normally idle and not used for trading, is deposited into protocols like Aave to earn further yield. The change will help to optimize the yield-earned on this pool by generating the following benefits:
-Make this pool more attractive for market participants due to increase of base yield through Aave lending fees;
-Enhanced yield generation if the BPT token is staked on Aura; and
-Lower cost of the voting incentives;

The ability to replace the current pool with a boosted one means an increase of the base yield thanks to the Aave lending fees. This can attract further liquidity, thus guaranteeing for the pool to be a focal point in the liquidity provisioning of Stargate in Arbitrum. Furthermore, the possibility to stake the POL in Aura will help to increase Stargate's influence within the Balancer ecosystem, which can be later used to support cost-effective STG liquidity and reduce protocol expenses.

Liquidity Providers improve their returns when staking the BPT token in Aura, because the APR is boosted by Aura emissions. This can incentivize third party liquidity providers within the Stargate community.

As the goal is for this boosted pool to be the major liquidity source for STG in Arbitrum, improving the base yield is a sensitive approach. The STG/bb-a-USD boosted pool that is the subject of this proposal has limited liquidity, so it does not promote current swaps or reflect any swap fee APR at this time, though it has boosted APR of 1.22%. These figures are also subject to fluctuation over time. If this proposal passes and we assume the current 1.61% swap fee APR of the existing 50/50 STG/USDC.e pool carries over, the boosted pool and the POL, if deposited, would generate 1.61% in swap fee APR, thus increasing the boosted pool's APR by 1.22% to 2.83%. Because the boosted STG/bb-a-USD pool has swap fees currently set to 1% compared to the lower 0.3% for the 50/50 STG/USDC.e pool, it's likely that the boosted version would provide increased swap fee APR and even more aggregate yield than 2.83%.

With the ability, in future, to further increase the yield of this pool through Aura incentive markets, the STG/Boosted Aave V3 USD pool will provide not only a base superior yield compared to the current solution, but also the flexibility to further grow liquidity in future if desired.

One further advantage of this proposal is that it will greatly benefit the Stargate protocol by enabling them to passively acquire more BAL/AURA tokens, thereby enhancing liquidity provisioning. As stated previously, Stargate already has a strategic position of not only protocol-owned liquidity but also AURA on mainnet. The proposed strategic integration will gradually make the process more cost-effective over time, ensuring Stargate's ability to grow their protocol while leveraging their assets across any chain in which the Balancer ecosystem is either already present or currently deploying. In this sense, the recent expansion of Aura protocol on several L2 (Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, and soon Gnosis), will play a key role.

-Execution-
$1.5M+ of POL will be moved from the current 50/50 pool to the already available Balancer 50/50 STG/Boosted Aave V3 USD pool on Abritrum, staked in Aura.

title: Deprecate the WOO liquidity pool on Fantom
body:
-Background-
On the 6th of July 2023, cross-chain bridge protocol Multichain was compromised, entailing the unauthorized withdrawal of $125M of various assets to an unknown address. Among the assets withdrawn were 9,674,426 WOO tokens that were thitherto being used to back the equivalent number of WOO tokens issued by Multichain protocol in the Fantom ecosystem 1:1.

To contain the risk of these unbacked WOO tokens within the Fantom ecosystem, WOO liquidity was shortly removed from Stargate’s pools on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Optimism. Instead, an alternative solution was implemented that enables all affected users to swap their unbacked WOO tokens out of Fantom to other blockchains via a service provided by WOO Network’s centralized exchange, WOO X.

-Proposal-
Before the removal of WOO liquidity from Stargate Bridge, the WOO token was one of the most bridged assets behind blue chips like ETH and stablecoins. This proposal kindly asks that Stargate DAO deprecate the WOO liquidity pool on Fantom now that efforts are being taken to wind down the WOO token in the Fantom ecosystem. Provided the Stargate DAO should agree to this, WOO Network will redeposit WOO token liquidity to six of Stargate’s chains (Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Optimism), reinstating a consistent and sizable source of fee generation for the Stargate DAO. 

The return of WOO liquidity to the Stargate Bridge will also be beneficial to WOOFi - the first DEX to integrate with Stargate Bridge to power one-click cross-chain swaps. While WOO token liquidity is absent, WOOFi cross-chain swaps can only route through Stargate’s ETH and stablecoin pools, hampering their ability to find the optimal path and best execution for WOOFi users.

-Execution-
-WOO Network to remove all WOO liquidity in Stargate on Fantom
-Stargate to deprecate the WOO pool and remove the option for users to bridge WOO tokens into or out of Fantom
-WOO Network to add back WOO token liquidity on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Optimism

-Summary-
As part of efforts to wind down the WOO token in the Fantom ecosystem following the incident with Multichain protocol, we beseech the Stargate DAO to deprecate the WOO liquidity pool on Fantom. This will enable WOO Network to re-deposit WOO liquidity on six of Stargate’s chains and bring back what was a consistent source of bridging volume and fees for the Stargate DAO. In the event that WOO Network decides to revive WOO token on Fantom in the future, LayerZero bridge will be our first choice.

title: Stargate Deployment on IDEX/XCHAIN
body:
TL;DR
-Deploy Stargate on IDEX & XCHAIN as the exclusive bridge provider
-Integrate Stargate directly into the IDEX application as the default option for depositing/withdrawing funds
-$500k in IDEX token incentives over 2 years to jumpstart liquidity

--Background--
Established in 2016, IDEX has set the standard as a premier high-performance decentralized exchange. The platform combines the speed and efficiency of traditional trading systems with the transparency and security of blockchain settlement to create an unparalleled trading experience. The design provides users with instant execution, millisecond latency, and gas-free settlement, all while allowing them to maintain full control and custody of funds.

In the next few months, IDEX will launch their perpetual futures platform on top of XCHAIN, an IDEX specific zkEVM L2 and the first of Polygon’s zkEVM supernets. XCHAIN brings the scalability and affordability necessary for an order book perpetual futures DEX to truly compete with centralized exchanges.

Key benefits of XCHAIN:
-Gas-free trade settlement
-Deposits and settlement secured by Ethereum
-Opportunity for additional dApps to serve IDEX users & capital
-Seamless integration and liquidity with Polygon 2.0 ecosystem

IDEX perpetuals are collateralized by USDC bridged and minted on XCHAIN via the L1 native bridge.

--Proposal--
IDEX proposes for Stargate to launch on XCHAIN, working with LayerZero to set up an endpoint on XCHAIN mainnet. IDEX is requesting to deploy a USDC pool on XCHAIN, with pathways to and from Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon.
-IDEX will provide a two-year grant of a guaranteed $500k (~10M IDEX tokens) to incentivize liquidity
-Stargate will be the exclusive bridge partner for XCHAIN, capturing all L2 <> XCHAIN and fast L1 <> XCHAIN bridge volume
-Stargate will be integrated directly into the IDEX application, with the bridge acting as the default, white labeled method for users to move in and out of XCHAIN.

Utilizing Stargate’s bridge and call mechanism will allow users to deposit bridged funds directly into the smart contracts, a seamless UX that ensures the majority of volume in and out of XCHAIN flows through Stargate, and, in the process, highlights LayerZero’s innovation in cross-chain messaging.

Additionally, Stargate and LayerZero will unlock cross-chain composability and serve as the foundation for expanding the availability of defi services to IDEX customers. Swap DEXs, lending platforms, and other defi primitives on connected networks will be integrated into IDEX, allowing users to access these products directly from XCHAIN and boosting Stargate usage and volume in the process. We see Stargate and LayerZero as critical components to expand the products available to IDEX users while we continue to focus the majority of our development efforts on the perpetual futures protocol.

--Integration--
-Add LayerZero endpoints to XCHAIN mainnet
-Deploy Stargate on XCHAIN and enable USDC pathways to and from Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon
-IDEX integrates Stargate seamlessly into the deposit/withdrawal workflow as the exclusive, white labeled bridge provider (DONE - pending testnet deployment)
-IDEX provides $500k of IDEX token incentives to jump start liquidity

--Summary--
IDEX and XCHAIN are the forefront of the next wave of app-specific networks and represent an inflection point in the importance of cross-chain messaging and bridge protocols. An exclusive integration between XCHAIN and Stargate will allow Stargate to capture all of the bridge volume for the network and continue to position itself as the leading cross-chain liquidity solution.

title: Transfer Ownership of TheAptosBridge to Stargate
body:
In late 2022, LayerZero launched TheAptosBridge, allowing users to bridge to and from Aptos from 6 chains. This bridge is the most popular bridge to and from Aptos, and has seen users send millions of transactions through it. Currently over >$18 million in wrapped assets reside on Aptos, supported by TheAptosBridge. These assets are the default asset to use on many popular Aptos protocols such as Pontem, Thala and many more.

LayerZero is proposing to hand ownership of TheAptosBridge over to the Stargate DAO. As the most popular bridge protocol in crypto today, Stargate is uniquely positioned to support the TheAptosBridge and ensure it has strong backing moving forward. 

If the DAO chooses to accept this, all websites, smart contracts and materials associated with TheAptosBridge will be transferred to Stargate and any future decisions around the state of the TheAptosBridge will rest with the Stargate DAO.

title: Renewed Liquidity Incentivization Mandate
body:
--Background--
On May 6, 2022, Stargate DAO voted to leverage its STG holdings to incentivize liquidity. This strategy involves paying out STG to veCRV holders, CVX holders, and Redacted Cartel (https://snapshot.org/#/stgdao.eth/proposal/0x456c84b723da125d1a4e7b53630b280228c5f2139c40f5dbc56fd3ace5b332ef).

On May 23, 2022, Stargate DAO voted to stake its STG/USDC LP on Convex to earn rewards (https://snapshot.org/#/stgdao.eth/proposal/0x48b26abbc97d94910503e65f02dbbc13f60a07265e49c2986405778978a9559d). The rewards are locked to further amplify the rewards earned, producing a compounding effect.

Through this mechanism, Stargate accumulates rewards in the form of CRV and CVX. Ideally, for every $1 of STG paid, Stargate earns greater than $1 in rewards.

Since then, several other proposals have passed that have diversified Stargate’s LP position into Yearn, StakeDAO, Aura Finance, BeethovenX, and most recently Velodrome. Rewards earned from these protocols are being staked and compounded in a similar fashion to Curve/Convex. As a result, Stargate is now accumulating additional assets such as yCRV, SDT, AURA, VELO, etc.

Over one year has passed since the initial governance vote and the DAO should reevaluate the effectiveness of this strategy.

The ultimate goal of liquidity incentivization is to generate additional POL for the DAO. Ideally, for every $1 of liquidity incentivization Stargate should earn greater than $1 in rewards. At the time of incentivization this is often the case. However, rewards are paid out in the token of the protocol (CRV, AURA, VELO, etc.) and are then locked up to compound rewards, earn additional yield and/or provide incentives to LP. This exposes the Stargate treasury to token price risk while accumulating assets that do not actively work within the protocol to reduce the amount of liquidity required to be rented via incentivization to allow Stargate to function smoothly.

The POL benefits of this strategy is highly volatile and heavily varies on a day-to-day basis depending on the price of STG and the price of the reward tokens. At any given point in time, Stargate may be up or down millions of dollars depending on individual token prices and the value of those tokens relative to STG. Profitability also depends on how it is measured: using the current STG price, or the STG price at the time of incentivization. At various points through the incentivisation strategies, Stargate has had hundreds of thousands of dollars in unrealised profits, or losses (depending on when token prices were observed).

--Proposal--
The current liquidity incentivization strategy exposes Stargate to unnecessary token price risk. Stargate as a protocol also does not benefit from holding these assets in the long-run, and should focus on accumulating POL that contributes to reducing the need for rented liquidity.

Instead of accumulating and compounding all rewards earned from liquidity incentivization, Stargate should periodically swap these rewards. Stargate should at current point sell all of it’s accumulated and unlocked rewards for ETH, where the mandate allows for it. Not only does this reduce token price risk, but also accumulates useful POL for the protocol, further reducing STG emissions paid out to LPs. As Stargate seeks to launch on various new L2s in the near future, accumulating ETH POL should also be a priority to enable ETH swaps between L2s without needing to incentivise as much liquidity.

Henceforth, Stargate should swap any accumulated rewards on a monthly basis into ETH, as the mandates allow for it. Should ETH not be available natively on the chain in question, stablecoins should be the accumulation priority.

This proposal also recommends that Stargate continue to allow up to $10M worth of STG per annum to be used for incentivisation, on the condition that a return of 1.5X ($1.50 for every $1 spent) can be achieved with any such strategy.

-Exceptions below-
Stargate has (at time of writing) $660k worth of locked $AURA tokens. Upon unlocking in November 2023, Stargate should aim to keep ~$500k worth of $AURA so as to maintain significant voting power to incentivise rewards to be directed to the STG-stables pool.

In a case where selling such a position would result in greater than -1.0% market impact, the position should be split into tranches over a suitable amount of days, such as to minimise the market impact.

Stargate currently holds various locked positions (e.g. SDT, VELO) where it should continue to hold these positions and by mandate may accumulate future long-term locked positions.

--Summary--
The profitability of Stargate DAO’s current liquidity incentivization program is highly volatile and subjects the DAO to large token price risk as it accumulates reward tokens (CRV, AURA, etc.). At this point, Stargate should swap the currently accumulated rewards into ETH so as to accumulate ETH help in POL, reducing the need for STG emissions, and reducing token price risk. Going forward, Stargate should do so on a monthly basis.

title: Lower TheAptosBridge Block Confirmations and Add Fees
body:
**Background**

Per a community vote (https://snapshot.org/#/stgdao.eth/proposal/0x73917ac1c09063a4776aea60176817f3aa3ee96b3a54f93ba9e9dddfc1add2ee) Stargate has taken ownership of TheAptosBridge. Stargate now runs the largest bridge to and from Aptos, allowing users to safely and securely bridge assets. Currently TheAptos bridge relies on LayerZero default finality to the chain as defined by LayerZero documentation (https://layerzero.gitbook.io/docs/technical-reference/mainnet/default-config) and a waiting period of approximately three days when bridging from Aptos back to another chain. TheAptosBridge is currently free to use in all directions for users and applications.

**Proposal**

Stargate should lower the block confirmations required to bridge from Aptos to 260 blocks (roughly 1 minute) and add a small fee of 7 basis points when returning from Aptos to other chains.

Other bridges that service Aptos have significantly faster transfer times from Aptos than Stargate. This reduces TheAptosBridge’s competitiveness in market and could lead to lower overall use. Reducing the block confirmations would allow Stargate to better align TheAptosBridge with the market. Protected by PreCrime (https://medium.com/layerzero-official/introducing-pre-crime-49bef4a581d5) this will have no security implications but create a better user experience for end users that use the bridge and applications that build on top of it.

Stargate should add a 7 basis point fee (0.07%) to TheAptosBridge only when transferring from Aptos. Transfers to Aptos should remain free. This will discourage users from abusing the bridge as a free transfer mechanism to hop between chains (for example transferring from Arbitrum to Aptos and then from Aptos to Optimism to not have to pay fees to move between the chains). If this is not implemented and the block confirmations are reduced, chain balances for underlying assets may heavily concentrate on a few chains, diminishing the utility of TheAptosBridge for applications and users alike. Stargate is also able to generate additional fees for the protocol by implementing this proposal building protocol owned liquidity.

**Execution**

If this proposal passes, Stargate should immediately reduce the block confirmations out of Aptos to 260 blocks (roughly 1 minute).
Stargate should also immediately turn on a 7 basis point fee for all outbound transfers from Aptos, to be accrued into the owning addresses (Stargate’s multisigs). These assets should be converted monthly to POL on each chain (the asset that has the highest protocol owned liquidity per chain) and used within Stargate’s liquidity pools to help boost protocol owned liquidity on each chain.

**Summary**

By owning TheAptosBridge Stargate has the chance to make the bridge a better user experience and general additional fees. Stargate should reduce block confirmations from Aptos to 260 blocks (roughly 1 minute) and add a 7 basis point (0.07%) fee for these transfers. This will make TheAptosBridge more usable for applications and users while generating additional value for Stargate.

title: Stargate Foundation 12-month Budget Proposal
body:
**Issue Statement**

Stargate Finance has grown exponentially in 2023 hitting major protocol milestones, including over $3.4B in monthly transaction volume and over $2M in monthly protocol fees generated.

While Stargate is a decentralized protocol supported by the DAO.  The Stargate Foundation executes certain operations upon the will of the DAO. This support necessitates a budgeting and administration of expenses. With the protocol growing significantly in terms of community, use, partnerships and development, the Foundation should have a budget to support the DAO. The level of support needed has grown such that the Foundation requires dedicated resource allocation, as will be detailed below.

**Proposal**

This proposal is for a 12-month budget (September 2023 - August 2024) based on an estimation of costs required by the Foundation to continue supporting the DAO in the following functional areas:

***Dedicated Support***

* Foundation requires a small team of people dedicated to operating within the Foundation and executing upon the will of the DAO. This includes functions such as, but not limited to, the following;
    - BD and Partnerships - e.g. supporting protocols that build of top of Stargate, liaising with chains that get approved for Stargate deployments
    - Community and Marketing - e.g. coordinating launch announcements to Stargate’s >650,000 person audience, planning/coordinating community calls
    - Strategy and Analytics - e.g. analysing Stargate’s progress to self-sufficiency, efficiency of the rebalancing fee/reward design
    - Other areas that present in future

***Technical Support (including audits)***

* The Protocol requires continual technical support to execute upon proposals mandated by the DAO, for example:
    - Configuring new chain/pool deployments
    - Data driven emissions mandate

* Stargate is also security-first and new contracts should continue to be heavily audited
* Foundation will continue to liaise with technical execution partners as and when needed

***Legal***

* Corporate service, registered agent and general counseling fees across jurisdictions

***Marketing***

* Stargate should perform some marketing function, supported by the Foundation, for example:
    - Events at conferences
    - Educational campaigns with teams like Galxe, Layer3, etc

***Other Operating Expenses***

* Recurring expenses for day-to-day operations (e.g Moderators, web hosting, email services, payment processing, Discord bots, other toolkits)

The operational funding will be transferred from the Protocol Multisigs to the designated Foundation Multisig wallet for ease of use and expenditure. An additional Operations wallet may be used for ease of payments. 

**Execution**

To obtain the funds, it is suggested to withdraw $900,000 in liquidity from the Polygon USDC pool. Furthermore, upon successful completion of this proposal, $900,000 worth of STG (priced on day of completion) should be sent to the Foundation multisig.

Upon successful governance vote, funds are transferred hereafter to the Foundation multisig wallet. The Stargate Foundation will be tasked with dispensing the budget according to the above framework. Below are the estimates.

 
![image](ipfs://bafkreih657l4daehca3f56mya3b7juvmrwsokblacjmpfk6tllqupdw3rm)

**Summary**

The Stargate Foundation does important work to support the Protocol and the mandate of the Stargate DAO. In order to continue providing support for the next 12-months, especially given the growth of the protocol and the community, the Foundation is requesting a budget of $1.8M. These funds will be transferred to the designated Foundation multisig and used for various functions including, but not limited to; dedicated support, technical support (including audits), legal, marketing and other operational expenditure.

title: Stargate New Oracle Configuration: Google Cloud Oracle
body:
-Background -
In SIP 26 (https://snapshot.org/#/stgdao.eth/proposal/0x0dabcc487407cab6a0d471f7c61a01e9e4729ae7426957fece376939f2875aa6) Stargate moved away from the LayerZero default configuration and adopted a fixed configuration. Today, Google Cloud launched an oracle on LayerZero, making a compelling offering from one of the largest organizations in the world available to anyone building on top of LayerZero. 

-Proposal-
Stargate should adopt The Google Cloud Oracle for all of its products (Stargate and TheAptosBridge). This will provide security backed by Google Cloud to Stargate, allowing it to take full advantage of the latest high profile oracle to become live on LayerZero. This will bolster confidence in Stargate, opening the door for even more protocols to build on top of the most used bridge in crypto.

-Execution-
Stargate will update its configuration to adopt the Google Cloud oracle on all chains where it is available for all Stargate products. For any chains where the oracle is not available, Stargate should remain on the current configuration and then migrate to The Google Cloud Oracle if it becomes available. 

-Summary-
Stargate stands to align itself with a titan of web2 by selecting the Google Cloud oracle in its configuration. Doing so should only increase confidence in Stargate and help bolster confidence in the market for Stargate's products.

title: Proposal for Stargate Deployment on Mantle
body:
-Background-
Mantle Network is an optimistic Ethereum layer-2 (L2) solution with an EVM-compatible execution environment. Mantle is DAO-governed and employs a modular approach to execution, consensus, settlement, and data availability. Mantle Network Mainnet Alpha was launched on July 17, 2023. Mantle Network has worked with the LayerZero team and endpoints have been deployed. As a next step, we aim to provide users with the ability to bridge assets to and from Mantle Network through Stargate.

-Proposal-

Deploy the following pools and pathways
-ETH: Mantle, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base
-USDC: Mantle, Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Base
-USDT: Mantle, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Polygon

-User Incentives and Application Support-

To be discussed between the Stargate Foundation and the Mantle Core Contributor Team (authorized by BIP-19) and Mantle Economics Committee (as authorized under MIP-25).

-Pool incentives to be provided by Stargate. STG should be emitted commensurate with SIP #23.
-Liquidity pool support from Mantle Treasury up to 10M USDx and 5K ETH (see recent Economics committee proposal: https://forum.mantle.xyz/t/ec-proposal-treasury-assets-in-support-of-applications/7943)
-Other MNT support is provided to the Stargate Foundation at a 1 MNT to 2 STG ratio according to STG token emissions. The exact calculation method to be discussed between the Mantle Core Contributor Team and Stargate Foundation, settled and reviewed on a quarterly basis. The rate of emissions can be modified at each quarterly review upon agreement of both parties.

title: Proposal to Approve Stargate Deployment on Scroll
body:
**Background**

Scroll is an L2 Scaling solution that is pushing the development of an Ethereum-equivalent zkEVM. Scroll is launching Mainnet in Q3 and has been live and battle tested on Goerli since February this year.

The goal of this proposal is to improve the user experience on Scroll by having Stargate deployed to offer users the ability to transfer assets onto (and out of) Scroll.

**About Scroll**

[Scroll](https://scroll.io/) is a bytecode-equivalent ZK-Rollup built upon Ethereum, designed for scaling without sacrificing security, developer, or user experience:

-   **Bytecode Equivalence & Developer Friendliness**: Scroll is bytecode-equivalent and builds upon Geth, enabling seamless migration of infrastructure and will support all existing development tools, including debuggers. Scroll has one of the most familiar developer experiences outside Ethereum itself. No bytecode re-audits will be required, minimizing the risk surface tremendously.
-   **Ethereum-native & Community first**: Scroll originated in close collaboration with the Ethereum Foundation's zkEVM research within the [PSE (Privacy and Scaling Explorations) group](https://github.com/privacy-scaling-explorations)---in fact, our team has contributed ~50% of the upstream PSE zkEVM codebase over the past 2 years. Scroll has been open source & peer reviewed since day one, our testnet has been permissionless since its inception, and we continuously [publish](https://twitter.com/VitalikButerin/status/1585145691311329280?s=20&t=v8fXgqmJV_M1gmDRNEj7GA) [research](https://twitter.com/leonardoalt/status/1614189758774665221?s=20&t=ZbiCsoXsUW-XxnhDwm9qwQ) in an effort to demystify the inner works of [zk circuits and cryptography](http://scroll.io/blog).
-   **Decentralization & Security**: Scroll is pioneering a first-of-its-kind decentralized sequencer network and is committed to outsource proof generation. In addition to that, Scroll has a strong in-house security team that found and reported bugs in fellow zk RU's proving systems in the past.

ZK-Rollups are widely considered to be the Holy Grail of Ethereum scaling. Scroll's vision is to build a fully EVM-compatible ZK-Rollup that any existing Ethereum application can easily migrate to. Scroll is currently live on Goerli Testnet today and is expected to launch on Mainnet in Q3. Testnet transactions can be observed on: <https://blockscout.scroll.io/>

**Proposal**

We propose for Stargate to launch on Scroll as early as possible pending our Mainnet Launch. We are also working with the LayerZero team to ensure an LZ endpoint will be deployed on Scroll following our launch.

We propose the following Stargate pools/pathways to be enabled on launch:

-   ETH: Ethereum <> Scroll
-   USDC: Ethereum <> Scroll

This will allow Stargate to capture user growth in the Scroll ecosystem while providing developers and users with crucial bridging infrastructure.

To bootstrap liquidity for the proposed pools, our contributors will deploy up to 1K ETH and 1M USD, respectively.

This will help ensure that enough liquidity is present at launch for users to transfer ETH & USDC.

**Execution**

If approved, Stargate will launch on Scroll shortly after our Mainnet launch in Q3, pending the deployment of LayerZero endpoints to Scroll.

The ETH and USDC pools/pathways are to be enabled with the deployment of Stargate on Scroll.

Pool incentives are to be determined by Stargate's governance as a function of pool utilization per [SIP 23](https://snapshot.org/#/stgdao.eth/proposal/0x7839f919ddd2c226ef0f050ce9250b0f1f41c1d94bf0ab8fdc9205b151fe3a2a).

**Summary**

Scroll is launching Mainnet in Q3 and the aim is to have Stargate as an early protocol launch partner, providing a win-win opportunity for both Stargate as a potential bridge leader in Scroll's ecosystem and users with the ability to bridge assets in and out of Scroll.

title: Phase out BUSD on Stargate
body:
Background
Feb 2023 / Paxos (BUSD minter) has been ordered by US regulators to stop issuing BUSD. https://www.theverge.com/2023/2/13/23597539/crypto-paxos-order-sec-binance-usd-stablecoin

Paxos has agreed to comply - and since Apr 2023, it has stopped minting BUSD. BUSD can only be redeemed by burning, meaning circulating supply of BUSD will trend towards zero over time. With no growth in sight and reducing utility over time, Stargate should reduce and ultimately close its BUSD pools, and reduce its exposure to zero. Binance has also confirmed to cease BUSD support by Feb 2024. Stargate should act on this sooner than later.

Proposal
This proposal is to
-Shut down BNB BUSD pool and associated pathways
-Swap all BUSD multisig holdings into another highly liquid, USD-pegged stablecoin

Execution
This proposal can be implemented immediately with minimal technical resources. 

Upon proposal passing
-Set BNB Chain BUSD pool into withdrawal only mode on Stargate UI
-Notify community of intent to wind down pool and encourage LP withdrawal before Oct 30th
-Stargate Protocol Funds (held in Multisig): Swap all BUSD on BNB Chain into another highly liquid USD-pegged stablecoin
-PancakeSwap LP: Exit current position, swap all BUSD into another highly liquid USD-pegged stablecoin, and re-enter with STG-(USD-pegged stablecoin) pairing.

1 week after passing
-Set BNB Chain BUSD pool emissions, and associated pathway weights, to 0.
-Stargate should withdraw any BUSD POL, and swap for another USD-pegged stablecoin.

2 weeks after passing
-Send notification to all BUSD pool farmers to unstake before/on Oct 30th

Summary
This proposes to remove all BUSD from Stargate by Oct 30th 2023 (or 2 weeks after passing) in response to Binance’s plan to cease redemption support by Feb 2024. This includes both the BUSD pool on Stargate, as well as any holdings in the Stargate multisig (LP or wallet positions).

title: Stargate Deployment On Meter
body:
### Background 
Meter.io had been working with Layerzero team to enable Layerzero endpoint from Meter to multiple blockchains.  Today Layerzero is one of the top transaction generating applications on Meter mainnet.  In this proposal we are aiming to deploy Stargate on Meter mainnet to allow on/off major crypto assets from multiple blockchains to Meter and bring more activities to Stargate.

### About Meter.io
Meter is a high performance blockchain built on hybrid PoS/PoW and HotStuff consensus.  It is Ethereum compatible, highly decentralized (currently 337 consensus nodes, scalable to thousands) with unique features like MEV/front running resistant, instant finality and a PoW created flatcoin for payments and transaction fees.  Meter has a unique feature lists that is taylor made for decentralized financial applications:

1. Censorship resistant.  Meter’s highly decentralized consensus ensures the network is highly decentralized and robust.  Transactions will be processed smoothly even the network is under attacks.
2. High throughput and instant finality designed for trading.  Meter is not only capable of processing thousand of transaction per second but also each ensuring each transaction in the blockchain is finalized with no possibility of rollbacks.  
3. Fair transaction ordering.  Each year, blockchain users lost billions of dollars due to MEV and front running attacks when they use Ethereum, L2 and other blockchains.  Meter is the only blockchain that is built from ground up to be MEV/front running resistant.  Users will enjoy the safe and smooth trading environment provided by Meter.
4. Fully decentralized flatcoin to build the future DeFi stack and ensure transaction costs both low and stable.  Meter has a dual token design, governance token MTRG used for PoS and security and gas token MTR created by PoW and used for paying transactions fees and bidding newly emitted MTRG.  Creating one MTR requires 10kwh of electricity burnt on mainstream Bitcoin miners.  Such design creates an economic equilibrium for MTR and made it the only non collateralized flatcoin that maintains its value over the past 3 years since its launch.  MTR is aim to complete Satoshi’s original vision of a sound money that is independent of the fiat system.

Currently Meter has a healthy ecosystem including DEX, lending, synthetic assets, liquid staking and games.  The existing bridge only supports USDC, USDT and ETH transfers between Ethereum and the Meter mainnet. The goal of this proposal is to improve the users experience by allowing them to on/off ramp Meter from multiple blockchains.
### Proposal
We propose to launch Stargate on the Meter mainnet with the support of the following endpoints:
- USDT (Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, BNB Chain, Base and Meter)
- USDC (Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, BNB Chain, Base and Meter)
- ETH(Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Base and Meter)
User incentives and application supports:
- Pools deployed on Meter should receive STG emission based on SIP#23
- The TVL incentive on the Stargate USDT & ETH LP pool is expected to receive Meter’s network token MTRG as rewards based on the [Meter TVL Incentive Program](https://docs.meter.io/developer-documentation/meter-developer-incentives/meter-tvl-incentive-program)
- Meter community will provide liquidity pool support up to 4M USDx and 2K ETH
- dApps leveraging Layerzero and Stargate will be supported based on the [Meter Developer Incentive Program](https://docs.meter.io/developer-documentation/meter-developer-incentives)

Meter team will also work closely with the Stargate team on various marketing activities to maximize the exposure and activities for both Stargate’s launch and continued success on the Meter network. 

### Summary
Meter and Stargate carry similar vision of a multichain fully connected blockchain Ineternet future.  This proposal will bring better user experience to Meter and more transaction volume and TVL for both Stargate and Meter.  Meter team is also working new multichain products like Sumer.money that leverages both Layerzero and Stargate.  It will become the begining of the official collaborations between the two teams.

title: Wind down MAI Pools
body:
**Background**

QiDao have historically maintained an Autonomous Pool Deployment of MAI tokens across 7 chains on Stargate. These pools are on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism and Metis. 

The QiDao team would like to wind down these pools as they are no longer going to be supported. 

**Proposal**

Stargate should allow QiDao to wind down these pools by setting weights across all pathways to 0. This will ensure that redeeming LP is easier for all users who hold S*MAI LP Tokens. 

Stargate should set all pools to redeem only mode in the UI, and block transfers between pools. This will allow the withdrawal of LP tokens for users and the QiDao team.

**Execution**

Set weights between MAI pools to 0, and set MAI pools to withdraw-only mode within the UI. 

Upon passing of this proposal, the community should be advised to withdraw their MAI from the relevant pools.

**Summary**

The QiDao team wishes to wind down the MAI Autonomous Pool Deployment. Stargate should allow for this by setting all chain path weights to 0 between MAI pools on the 7 chains it is deployed on.

title: PancakeSwap veCAKE Proposa
body:
-Summary-
To boost liquidity, reduce slippage, and increase volumes for STG-TOKEN pairs on PancakeSwap, PancakeSwap is requesting Stargate DAO to lock up the DAO’s existing holdings of ~82,000 CAKE as veCAKE for 4 years. This stash of veCAKE will be used to vote for STG-TOKEN gauges on PancakeSwap every 2 weeks, starting with the STG-USDC (0.25%) gauge on Ethereum PancakeSwap.

-Background-
PancakeSwap is launching a new veCAKE gauge system, similar to Curve’s veCRV and Balancer’s veBAL. Users can lock up CAKE for a maximum of 4 years, and then vote for gauges on PancakeSwap every 2 weeks. 
Based on the amount of vote each gauge receives, the respective liquidity pair (e.g. STG-USDC) will receive a pro-rata amount of CAKE emission. This CAKE emission is used to attract users to deepen liquidity for the specific pair, reducing slippage and encouraging higher trading volumes for that pair.
Stargate DAO currently has ~$5.8M of STG-USDC protocol-owned liquidity (POL) on Ethereum PancakeSwap. The POL has seen extremely effective utilization, with APRs currently at 17% based on CAKE incentives and liquidity provider fees.

By voting for this gauge (and other STG-TOKEN gauges in the future) with veCAKE regularly, the DAO can further deepen their liquidity on this highly effective trading venue. 

-Proposal-
a) Grant amount: PancakeSwap is requesting Stargate DAO to lock up 100% of the DAO’s existing CAKE holdings, of roughly ~82,000 CAKE at the time of posting, as veCAKE for 4 years. Stargate’s multisig currently has ~82,000 CAKE accrued from yield farming. Note: Due to the potential time difference between the posting and execution of this proposal, the final amount of CAKE locked up may be greater than 82,000 CAKE.

b) Use of grant: Stargate DAO will use the veCAKE to vote for the STG-USDC (0.25%) gauge on Ethereum PancakeSwap every two weeks. As PancakeSwap’s gauge system is multichain, it is possible to vote for STG-TOKEN gauges on other chain deployments as well.

c) Re-lock mechanism: To ensure the voting power remains high, Stargate DAO commits to re-lock the entire CAKE amount, including CAKE earned from emissions, regularly for 4 years. The community may enact another proposal if they wish to stop the re-lock process. 
Execution

If the proposal is successful, the Stargate team will lock all CAKE earned from yield farming (~82,000 at time of proposal) for 4 years as veCAKE. Once the veCAKE gauge system is live, Stargate will vote for the STG-USDC (0.25%) gauge on Ethereum PancakeSwap every 2 weeks and re-lock all CAKE (the original amount + new CAKE earned from emissions) for 4 years regularly.
If the Stargate DAO enacts to seed liquidity for other STG-TOKEN pairs on PancakeSwap in the future, the Stargate team can direct all or some of the veCAKE voting power towards those gauges as well.

-Success-
If successful, this proposal will result in a sustainable APR paid to Stargate DAO for hosting liquidity on PancakeSwap, enabling the DAO to further reap benefits from the deployment of its POL on a highly effective trading venue.
